paper_title: SimSMoE Solving Representational Collapse via Similarity Measure
caption: : StableMoE Routing Policy

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the validation performance of two models, StableMoE and SimSMoE, over various training steps. The x-axis represents "Training Steps", expressed in units of 10^3, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 50, and regular tick intervals at every 10 units. The y-axis is labeled "BPC", using a linear scale ranging from 1.25 to 2.25, with tick marks at intervals of 0.25. The cyan line with star-shaped markers represents the StableMoE Validating performance. It starts at approximately 2.25 BPC at the initial training step, showing a steep decline till 1.25 at step 10 and then gradually decreasing to around 1.1 BPC by the 50,000 training steps mark. The magenta line with circle-shaped markers represents the "SimSMoE Validating" performance. It follows a similar declining pattern, beginning also at about 2.25 BPC and decreasing to roughly the same level as the cyan line, around 1.1 BPC at the endpoint, just below cyan line. Both lines appear to demonstrate an initial sharp decrease, followed by a more gradual decline stabilizing toward the end. A legend is given top right.
